decision_floors.grounded: Under the Wireless Content License Agreement between Fox and Sorrent, Inc., Fox grants Sorrent, Inc. a limited, exclusive (except as otherwise provided in the agreement), non-transferable (except as permitted in Paragraph 17(d)) right and license to make, have made, reproduce, modify, create derivative works of, advertise, promote, distribute, sell and license the Wireless Products, solely for use on mobile or cellular telephones (the Wireless Platform), in the Territory, during the Term, for distribution through the Distribution Channels, and by means of periodic subscription fee, a per-download basis, or through a retail purchase.

Under the Wireless Content License Agreement between Fox and Sorrent, Inc., Fox and Vodafone Group Services Limited (VGSL) have entered into a wireless content distribution agreement (the VGSL Agreement) whereby Fox is to be the content provider for VGSL wireless products relating to various Properties, and Fox desires a license to distribute Wireless Products to VGSL pursuant to the VGSL Agreement.

Under the Wireless Content License Agreement between Fox and Sorrent, Inc., Fox grants Sorrent, Inc. a limited, exclusive (except as otherwise provided in the agreement), non-transferable (except as permitted in Paragraph 17(d)) right and license to use, make, have made, reproduce, modify, and create derivative works of the PSM in each Property, solely to develop the wireless applications set forth for each Property on Exhibits B through M (the Wireless Products).

Under the Wireless Content License Agreement between Fox and Sorrent, Inc., Sorrent, Inc. shall remain the primary contact under the agreement and shall remain liable for all obligations performed by a sublicensee.

Under the Wireless Content License Agreement between Fox and Glu Mobile, Glu Mobile expressly acknowledges and agrees that Fox has entered into the VGSL Agreement with VGSL for the development of certain Wireless Products set forth on Exhibits B, C, D and G, in connection with the Properties "Robots," Untitled Ridley Scott Film, "Ice Age 2," and "Mr & Mrs. Smith."
